title: Austin Land Deals: Hospital, Flood Control, Water
summary:
*   City leaders discussed significant real estate transactions concerning Brackenridge Hospital.
*   Plans advanced for the Creek Bend Flood Control Project with talks about acquiring necessary land.
*   Discussions also covered securing easements for a new water booster pump station.
